blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—Sean Salvador played for more than school pride in Jose Rizal University’s dramatic win over Letran in Game 1 of the NCAA Season 102 men’s basketball Final Four on Monday night. Following the Heavy Bombers’ 102-98 overtime victory over the Knights, coach Nani Epondulan revealed that Salvador could’ve opted not to suit up in the semifinals opener as he’s dealing with the recent passing of his mother. Despite the pain, Salvador put on a brave face and played hero for JRU alongside Lawrence Mangubat to push the Bombers a game closer to the Finals. “I wanted this. This is the […]...
